functions.name: prevent_vault_mutation
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_vault_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  raise exception '% records are append-only', tg_table_name;
end;
$function$

functions.name: seal_audit_event
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.seal_audit_event()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(new.case_id);

  select event_hash
    into new.previous_event_hash
  from public.case_audit_events
  where case_id = new.case_id
  order by id desc
  limit 1;

  new.event_hash := encode(
    extensions.digest(
      concat_ws(
        '|',
        new.case_id::text,
        new.operator_id::text,
        new.action,
        new.details::text,
        coalesce(new.previous_event_hash, ''),
        new.created_at::text
      ),
      'sha256'
    ),
    'hex'
  );

  return new;
end;
$function$
